topic: The one event detail companies always underfund — and why it kills the whole experience
hook: Most companies spend 80% of their budget on the venue and wonder why nobody's talking about the event a week later.
script_he: רוב החברות מוציאות 80% מהתקציב על הוונו — ושוכחות שהאנשים לא זוכרים את החדר, הם זוכרים את הרגע. אחרי 16 שנה ו-1,500 אירועים, אני יכולה להגיד לכם בביטחון: הזיכרון הכי חזק נוצר ב-20 הדקות הראשונות. הקבלה, המוזיקה, הריח, הדבר הראשון שרואים — זה מה שקובע את כל הטון. אם לא תשקיעו שם, שאר האירוע פשוט לא מגיע לפוטנציאל שלו. רוצים לדעת איך בונים את הרגע הזה נכון? שלחו לנו הודעה.
script_en: Most companies spend 80% of their budget on the venue — and then wonder why nobody's talking about the event a week later. After 16 years and over 1,500 events across 130 destinations, here's what I know for certain: the strongest memory is made in the first 20 minutes. The arrival, the music, the scent, the very first thing people see — that sets the tone for everything. If you underinvest there, the rest of the event never reaches its potential. Want to know how to build that moment right? DM us.
captions: Most companies get this completely wrong.
post_caption: Your guests decided how they felt about your event before the first speaker even opened their mouth. 👀 The arrival experience is the most underfunded, most underestimated moment in corporate event production — and after 1,500+ events we see this mistake on repeat. Fix the first 20 minutes, and everything else gets better. 🎯 Drop a 🙋 if you've ever been to an event where the entrance felt like an afterthought. #EventProduction #CorporateEvents #IncentiveTravel #HRLeaders #EventStrategy #B2BMarketing
